title: Find your primal posture and sit without back pain: Esther Gokhale at TEDxStanford
summary: Esther Gokhale's short TEDx talk argues that the natural human spine is curved rather than straight and teaches a 'primal posture' for sitting without back pain.
why: Recommended in back pain and posture threads as a short, practical idea that helped some commenters.

quote.text: I found this Ted talk helped me with some lower back and leg issues.
